doc.citation: Noetinger, S. and di Pasquo, M.M. (2011). Devonian palynological assemblages from the San Antonio x-1 Borehole, Tarija Basin, northwestern Argentina. Geologica Acta, 9(2), 199–216.
doc.comment: SA1 overlaps the requested window but extends into the Eifelian; its taxa cannot individually be assigned an Emsian age. SA2 and SA3 are younger and excluded. Fig. 3's assemblage brackets conflict with assignments in the discussion: its SA1 bracket includes BAFC-Pl 2037, explicitly assigned to SA2 in the text, and plots Grandispora gabesensis below SA3 despite the text calling it exclusive to SA3. Disputed occurrences are identified in their locators. The study expands the 23-sample investigation of Noetinger and di Pasquo (2007), Preliminary studies of Devonian microfloras of a borehole from the Tarija Basin, Northwestern Argentina, to 55 samples.

items.locality: San Antonio range, Tarija Basin, northwestern Argentina
items.age_as_reported: late Emsian to the mid Eifelian
items.age_basis_detail: Grandispora protea and Grandispora douglastownense support correlation with late Emsian–early Eifelian spore zones. Ancyrochitina parisi and Ramochitina ramosi suggest latest Emsian–early Eifelian for 3616–3584m. Other spores have Eifelian or younger published ranges; the authors adopt a broader late Emsian–mid Eifelian age because the material consists of cutting samples.
items.setting_as_reported: nearshore, shallow marine depositional conditions characterized by a high terrestrial input and variable marine influence
items.notes: Continental elements constitute 93%; biodiversity is relatively low, spores relatively small, preservation variable and cuticles concentrated. Chitinozoan fragments first occur at BAFC-Pl 2040 (3150-3152m). The basal formation attribution is tentative: the authors assign the middle succession to Los Monos and suggest upper Huamampampa for its base. Reworking is not claimed; possible contamination by caving is discussed and cannot be excluded for cutting samples. Fig. 3 brackets 22 sample rows, BAFC-Pl 1983 through 2007, as SA1, but this conflicts with some textual assemblage assignments. The occurrence list retains explicit SA1 prose records and records supported by that plotted bracket or its sample-linked captions; disputed assignments are flagged individually. Illustrated indicates that the taxon is figured somewhere in this paper, not necessarily from an undisputed SA1 sample. Table I is a whole-borehole inventory and has not been assigned wholesale to SA1. Its sole cryptospore, Dyadospora murusattenuata Morphon, is described as occurring from Eifelian to Frasnian and illustrated from BAFC-Pl 1981, outside the plotted SA1 bracket; it is not securely assigned here to SA1.
